rotator-bot: Alert: spike in tls.handshake_failures in eu-central-1 and ap-northeast-2 since 2025-11-02T03:14Z (~3.9%).
Nina: seeing errors from api-gw and inference-edge, 502s and tls handshake timeouts.
Omar: rotator ran scheduled intermediate promotion at 03:00. Keystore shows KMS Decrypt AccessDenied for alias/rotator-eu:v3.
Jules: log snippet: [2025-11-02T03:00:10Z] rotator: ERROR kms:Decrypt AccessDenied for alias/rotator-eu:v3 -> probe shows incomplete private key unwrap. proxy logs: tls: handshake failed: missing_private_key.
Theo: likely IAM policy drift during cross-region migration. Quick mitigation: re-deploy previous cert chain to gateways from backups and stage canary pods.
Nina: I have s3://rotator-backups/eu/20251101-prev.pem, pushing to 2 pods now.
Omar: propose immediate fixes: 1) Nina -> rollback certs to last_good 2) Jules/Security -> add kms:Decrypt to rotator role for affected ARNs + run iam:simulatePrincipalPolicy 3) Theo -> emit audit events for KMS unwrap failures and rotator publishes 4) disable TLS session tickets briefly to avoid resume mismatches.
Jules: I'll open PR with scoped policy and include condition for rotator principal, add CI test to verify Decrypt permission pre-rotation.
Theo: after rollback handshake failure rate dropped 3.9% -> 0.6% in 60s. Opening incident SEC-20251102-01 and moving discussion there.
rotator-bot: Incident created SEC-20251102-01.
Nina: moving thread to #incidents/SEC-20251102-01 for follow ups.
